verdict.rationale: Morph publishes concrete high-throughput numbers (10,500+ tok/s Fast Apply, 33,000 tok/s Compact, ~90ms classifiers, prefix caching with no surcharge) aimed squarely at low-latency/high-throughput serving, and independent community use (goose author) corroborates a real speed boost in practice. Missing for 10: explicit time-to-first-token benchmarks and independent third-party throughput verification beyond vendor docs and one anecdotal HN comment.
